Chattanooga’s Most Advanced
Specialty & Emergency Veterinary Hospital
Welcome to Veterinary Care and Specialty Group (VCSG), Chattanooga’s largest and most trusted veterinary specialty and emergency hospital. Since 2016, we’ve been redefining veterinary care by combining state-of-the-art medicine with unparalleled compassion. Our close-knit team of over 150 veterinary professionals is dedicated to providing world-class care for your pets while fostering trust and collaboration with pet owners and referring veterinarians alike.
At VCSG, every specialty service is led by a board-certified specialist, ensuring your pet receives the highest standard of expertise. Our comprehensive diagnostic and treatment capabilities under one roof set us apart, allowing us to offer innovative treatments such as total hip replacements, I-131 therapy, advanced radiation oncology, and much more. We’re proud to be a regional leader in veterinary specialty medicine, offering support, guidance, and renowned care for pets and their families from hours away.
Refer a Patient
Call Us
Expertise You Can Count On
At VCSG, excellence starts with our team of board-certified specialists. Every department, from oncology to internal medicine, is led by experts who have achieved the highest level of veterinary specialization. This commitment to exceptional care ensures your pet receives advanced, precise, and compassionate treatment for even the most complex conditions.
What Does It Mean to Be Board-Certified?
Board certification represents years of advanced training and rigorous examinations beyond standard veterinary education. It signifies prowess in a specific area of veterinary medicine, from surgery and neurology to critical care and radiation oncology. At VCSG, this expertise translates into outstanding care for your pet.
Why Our Specialists
Stand Out
With board-certified specialists guiding every service, you can trust that your pet is in the hands of experts dedicated to excellence. This level of expertise draws families from across the region and ensures that VCSG remains the premier choice for specialty veterinary care.
Meet Our Specialists
Advanced Training
Board-certified specialists complete extensive residencies and certification exams in their area of expertise, ensuring mastery in their field.
Focused Expertise
From oncology to surgery, internal medicine and beyond, our specialists have dedicated their careers to solving the most complex medical challenges.
Collaborative Care
Our team works together across specialties to provide comprehensive, personalized treatment plans for your pet.
Commitment to Innovation
Staying at the forefront of veterinary medicine, our specialists continually adopt the latest advancements and techniques to ensure your pet benefits from cutting-edge care.
Advanced Veterinary Specialty Services
in Chattanooga
At VCSG, we bring unrivaled expertise to every case. Our board-certified specialists use innovative approaches to provide the best outcomes for pets facing serious health challenges. Our specialty services include:
Emergency & Critical Care
Internal Medicine

Surgery
Oncology

Rehabilitation
Blood Bank
Join Our Lifesaving Mission
Did you know that VCSG operates the only veterinary blood bank in Chattanooga? Our lifesaving blood bank relies on generous donors to support pets in critical need. By enrolling your dog or cat in our donor program, you’ll be helping to save lives while receiving benefits such as free annual health screenings for your pet.
Becoming a donor is simple, and our team will guide you through every step of the process. To learn more and see if your pet qualifies, visit our Blood Bank page or call us today. Together, we can make a difference.
